name: How does the custom cabinetry design process work with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: How does the custom cabinetry design process work with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Hometelligent Inc., our custom cabinetry design process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, needs, and budget. Our designers then create detailed 3D renderings and floor plans, allowing you to visualize your new kitchen and make adjustments. We work collaboratively to refine the design, select materials, and finalize every detail. A critical step is the site visit to take precise measurements, ensuring the cabinetry perfectly fits your kitchen space, particularly for homes with unique architectural features commonly found in areas like Piedmont or Albany.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our design process involves an initial consultation, 3D renderings, collaborative refinement, material selection, and precise on-site measurements.
